check: The first screen says who it is for, what changes for them and how, in plain words.
A stranger can say what the product does after five seconds on the first screen.
The hero artifact is the product or its real output, not decoration.
Each of the visitor's first three doubts is answered by a specific artifact on the page.
Every section tells the visitor something the sections above did not; repeated claims are cut.
There is one primary action, worded the same wherever it appears.
Questions to the user carried a recommended default; unanswered ones were assumed and logged.
Two hero variants that differ on one named axis (structure, density, emphasis, type or voice) were compared and scored before any code.
Two references serve different jobs, one counterexample is named, and what is not borrowed is stated.
The page starts from one archetype recipe and records where it departs from it.
The headline and primary action are visible without scrolling at 1440×900 and 390×844.
A centred headline above a framed screenshot is used only with a product reason in the record.
The headline has no single-word last line at any of the three widths.
A headline above about 6.5rem is the signature of the page and keeps each line to three words or fewer.
The primary action names what the visitor will do, not "Get started" or "Learn more" alone.
The hero is sized with svh/dvh or content, not a fixed 100vh that clips under mobile browser bars.
Nothing in the hero waits for an animation before it can be read.
Exactly one h1.
Heading levels never skip (no h1 → h3).
The h1 and the first h2 are each at least 1.25× the body size.
At least two font weights carry the hierarchy.
Headline letter-spacing is no tighter than −0.04em.
Text above 14px is not tracked wider than 0.12em, and no paragraph is set in all caps.
Body text is at least 16px on phones.
No readable text below 11px.
Body paragraphs stay under about 80 characters per line.
Body line-height is at least 1.35.
Weights under 400 appear only at 28px and up; smaller text is 400 or heavier.
A display face that is everywhere (Inter, Space Grotesk, Fraunces, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat) has a stated reason.
Each face has a role (display, text, data); a family is not added just to have two.
No horizontal scroll at 390px.
No horizontal scroll at 320px.
No text is cut off by its container.
Body text keeps at least 12px from the screen edge on phones.
Sections do not all share one padding; spacing changes where the reading task changes.
No boxed card sits inside another boxed card.
Density changes down the page on purpose: open, dense, quiet, active, short.
In-page anchor targets are not hidden under a sticky header.
A footer exists and holds real destinations.
At 768px nothing is a cramped leftover of the desktop grid.
Text meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text).
No gradient-filled text.
No coloured glow or halo used as decoration.
Depth does not come from a hairline border plus a wide soft shadow on every surface.
The ground colour is chosen from where the product is used; cream with a serif display needs a reason.
Accent colour marks state or action and is not sprinkled for decoration.
The theme-color meta matches the page background.
No row of three equal cards with short adjective headings standing in for a product explanation.
No icon tile stacked above every card heading.
No small tracked-caps label above nearly every section heading.
Section numbers appear only on content that is a real sequence.
No thick coloured stripe down one side of cards or callouts.
No pulsing dot, blinking cursor or marquee on content that is not live.
No stock marketing verbs (seamless, supercharge, unleash, revolutionize, cutting-edge, next-gen).
No grid, dot or stripe background used as filler.
Replacing the logo would not turn this into another company's page.
The signature idea still works if the palette changes.
Compared with each reference on copy, names, numbers, imagery, layout and motion, no distinctive element or combination is reproduced.
With reduced motion, nothing moves and nothing is hidden.
After loading and one scroll, no text is still invisible.
No transition: all.
Only transform, translate, scale, rotate and opacity animate; never layout properties.
Nothing large loops forever without a way to pause it.
Overshoot or bounce easing appears only in playful archetypes; entrances never start from scale(0) or ease in.
Hover-only effects sit behind (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine).
Staggers stay between 30 and 80ms and never block input.
Every animation has a written contract: trigger, purpose, fallback, duration, easing.
Text that must be read moves into place rather than fading in.
The viewport meta never disables zoom.
Header, nav and boxed buttons are at least 44px tall.
Every other control is at least 24px tall.
Inputs use at least 16px text, so phones do not zoom on focus.
If the nav collapses on phones, a working menu control replaces it.
Dense artifacts are recomposed for phones, not shrunk.
Fixed or full-bleed elements respect safe-area insets.
At 200% zoom (720px at 2×) the page still has no horizontal scroll.
Every link and button has an accessible name.
Every image has alt text, empty only when decorative.
Decorative SVGs are hidden from assistive tech; meaningful ones are labelled.
Every focusable control looks different when focused from the keyboard.
Nothing is clickable without being a link or button.
Every form control has a label.
The page has a main landmark.
The html element declares a language.
No script errors or console errors while loading.
Links point somewhere real: no empty href, "#" or missing anchor or file.
No broken images.
Results of local actions are announced (aria-live or role=status).
Images declare width and height, or an aspect-ratio.
Images below the first screen load lazily.
Web fonts use font-display: swap (or optional).
The first load transfers under about 2.5 MB.
No customer logos or testimonials that were not supplied and verified.
Every number has a source or is labelled illustrative.
Illustrative interfaces say so on the page.
The primary action leads somewhere real or produces a visible local result.
Every screenshot listed as evidence was opened, is not blank and is the width it claims.
One structural revision was made after rendering, with before and after evidence and the hero rescored.
Every decorative element left on the page has a named job; ones without a job were removed and are listed.
verify-record.mjs exits 0 and the final reply ends with the record's status line.
